reading: Carrying the world in the session loop turned off the per-iteration release, so every frame's temporary memory stayed on the bump stack until it was full. With the release decided at run time by whether the carried block changed, and no block copy for a write through an array, the converted game runs 200,000 frames at the per-frame time of the game before the conversion.
